_comment: Pirates and the open sea (systems/pirates.js): named pirate captains who persist and remember you, their havens on the map, the infamy a player-pirate earns and the hunters it sends after them, merchant prey, and the sea events of Explore the Waters (each a choice). Odds are fractions; [lo, hi] ranges are rolled.

seaEvents.title: A Drifting Derelict
seaEvents.text: A hulk wallows in the swell, sails in rags, no one at the wheel. Something went badly wrong aboard her.

options.label: Board and search her
options.hint: Whatever she carried may still be aboard — or whatever killed her crew.

success.text: In the captain's cabin: a strongbox and a few casks still sound.

failure.text: The stench below was the flux. Some of it came back aboard with you.

options.label: Strip her timbers and fittings
options.hint: Slow, safe salvage: certain but modest.

success.text: Your carpenters strip her of good timber and brass; your own hull gets a patch or two.

options.label: Leave her to the sea
options.hint: Some ships are better left alone.

success.text: You sail on. The crew mutters a prayer as she falls astern.

seaEvents.title: Smoke on a Sandbar
seaEvents.text: A thin column of smoke rises from a sandbar: castaways, waving shirts on oars.

options.label: Send the boat for them
options.hint: Hands for your crew and a good deed — if they are what they seem.

success.text: Shipwrecked sailors, grateful to the bone. Some sign on; one tells of land nobody charts.

failure.text: Mutineers marooned for cause: they knifed two of your men and made off with the purse before you put them ashore again.

options.label: Throw them a cask and sail on
options.hint: A small mercy without the risk.

success.text: You float a cask of water and biscuit to them. They will live a while yet.
The crew watch the smoke a long time.

seaEvents.title: Lights Over the Water
seaEvents.text: At dusk a green glow dances on the horizon, where the charts show nothing at all.

options.label: Follow the lights
options.hint: A day off your course. Sailors' tales say such lights mark uncharted land.

success.text: By moonlight you take a bearing on a dark shape the charts do not show.

failure.text: The lights led you onto shoals. You scrape free with a gash in the hull.

success.text: The glow fades. The crew sleep badly.

seaEvents.title: A Bottle in the Swell
seaEvents.text: A sealed bottle bobs alongside, wax still on the cork.

options.label: Fish it out and open it
options.hint: Letters, a will — or a map.

success.text: Inside: a stained chart with an X and a drowned man's last boast.

failure.text: A love letter, and a coin for luck.

success.text: The bottle drifts away on the tide.

seaEvents.title: Something Rises From the Deep
seaEvents.text: The sea boils. A tentacle as thick as a mast slaps the deck.

options.label: Fight it
options.hint: Harpoons, axes and your guns against the beast.

success.text: It sinks back, bleeding ink. Ambergris and a wrecked ship's gold tangled in its arms come aboard.

failure.text: It tears at the rigging and drags men under before it tires of you.

options.label: Pour burning oil on the water
options.hint: Costs your lamp oil, if you carry any; fire may drive it off.

success.text: The burning slick drives it under. You are away before it returns.

failure.text: It comes up through the flames.

options.label: Crowd on sail and run
options.hint: Speed against something that lives here.

success.text: You outrun it, the crew laughing like madmen.

failure.text: It catches your stern before you clear its water.

seaEvents.title: A Squall Line
seaEvents.text: A black wall of cloud comes down on you, the sea white under it.

options.label: Reef sails and ride it out
options.hint: Slow and careful; a little damage at most.

success.text: You ride it out under bare poles.

failure.text: Even reefed, the squall springs a seam.

options.label: Run before it
options.hint: Use the wind: miles gained, or a mast lost.

success.text: You fly before the gale; the crew whoop as the miles run past.

failure.text: A spar goes over the side, and a man with it.

seaEvents.title: Whales Off the Bow
seaEvents.text: A pod of whales breaches, close enough to wet the deck.

options.label: Heave to and watch
options.hint: A good omen, the old hands say.

success.text: The crew take it as a blessing.

options.label: Lower the boats and hunt
options.hint: Oil and meat — and a whale's tail can stove in a boat.

success.text: A long, ugly day's work, and the hold full of oil and meat.

failure.text: A flukes-blow smashes a boat; two men don't come back.

seaEvents.title: A Sail on the Horizon
seaEvents.text: The lookout calls a sail — and no honest flag.
